capabilities: Push managed frontmatter fields (name, org, emails, phones) from contact notes to a macOS Contacts group
Stamp matched Mac cards with a UUID marker and obsidian:// back-link so matching survives renames
Generate a sync report classifying each contact as in-sync, updated, created, edited-in-mac, orphan-mac, or suggestion
Run dry-run and confirm-before-write checks before touching Contacts.app
Create contact notes from a template and bulk-adopt orphan Mac cards
extras: macOS only. Requests capabilities beyond typical plugins: shell execution (osascript/JXA), filesystem access outside the vault for temp files, and vault-wide file enumeration; the plugin explains why each is needed. Community plugin submission is pending review, so manual install may be required; further docs in docs/INSTALLATION.md. No network calls or telemetry.
intentEvidence: This is a deliberate inversion of raulanatol/obsidian-mac-sync-contacts
motivation: The author deliberately inverted the pull-based approach of existing contact-sync plugins so the full record stays in Obsidian while only minimal fields reach Contacts.app.
problem: Existing Obsidian contact tools pull contacts from Apple or Google into the vault, but none keep Obsidian as the source of truth and push only caller-identifying fields to macOS Contacts.
